page.layout: One column of text on the main (left) printed page, centred; page number and running head at the top. Right of the page edge a fragment of the facing page with partial margin text (not transcribed as text block, only noted). No notes in the text column.

main_text.p: Et tandem Aristoteles Solus habet mentem, reliquis errantibus umbris:

Affingunt iis Sententias, quas nunquam senserunt, de quibus fortè ne per somnium quidem cogitaverunt: Si monstrari tibi petas, ubi tandem, ubi Veteres illa dixerint, Respondent, quod res est, Eorum plerorumque commentarios, injuriâ temporis intercidisse: ut nempe vel hoc solo indicio clarè intelligas, totum hoc fermè commentum, imaginariis eorum conjecturis deberi.
Restat ANOMALIA, congeries immensa sordium: Augiæ stabulum dixeris: & Herculeus profectò labor est illud expurgare:

page.notes: Fragment of the facing right-hand page is visible at the right edge (partly cut words such as "Quæs", "gare", "per cun", "que sun", "modate", "Physic", "Gram"); not transcribed. Italic words in the text are rendered as printed. Possible long-s and ligature forms normalised to plain s.
